falseFriends.performance: Use 'prestazione' for OEE performance rate, not 'performance' (anglicism for artistic/show performance)
falseFriends.station: Use 'stazione di lavoro' for workstation, not 'stazione' alone (train/radio station)
falseFriends.setup: Use 'attrezzaggio' or 'messa a punto', not 'setup' (means computer setup in Italian)
falseFriends.yield: Use 'resa' for manufacturing yield; financial yield = 'rendimento' — context-specific
falseFriends.demand: Use 'domanda' carefully — also means 'question' or 'job application'
falseFriends.billion: Use 'miliardo' (10^9), not 'bilione' (which means 10^12 in Italian long scale)
falseFriends.idle: Use 'inattivo' or 'in attesa', not 'pigro' (lazy — pejorative for machines)
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'scarto' for manufacturing defective; 'rifiuto' = garbage; 'sfrido' = cutting waste in metalworking

grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Two genders; 'il rendimento' (m), 'la qualità' (f). Compound terms with 'tempo di' always masculine.
grammarNotes.compoundWords: Italian uses prepositional phrases: 'tempo di ciclo' (cycle time), 'tempo di fermo' (downtime)
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Comma for decimal, period for thousands: '1.234,56'. Percentage: '85%' (no space).
grammarNotes.articlesWithMetrics: Use definite articles with metrics in sentences: 'l'OEE è all'85%'. In UI labels, omit articles.
grammarNotes.scartoDistinction: 'Scarto' = manufacturing defective. 'Rifiuto' = garbage. 'Sfrido' = cutting waste in metalworking.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In prepositional compound phrases, the modifier noun after 'di' stays SINGULAR when naming a concept/category. CORRECT: 'cause di perdita di velocità' (causes of loss [sg] of speed). WRONG: 'cause delle perdite di velocità' (causes of-the losses [pl] of speed). The article 'delle' (di+le) signals incorrect pluralization of the modifier. Same pattern: 'motivi di fermo' (reasons of stop [sg]), not 'motivi dei fermi'. Only the head noun takes plural.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE acronym is commonly used in Italian manufacturing. Full forms: 'Efficienza Complessiva degli Impianti' — descriptive only.
industryContext.wcmFiat: World Class Manufacturing (WCM) — a TPM/lean hybrid developed by Fiat — is extremely influential in Italian industry.
industryContext.industry40: 'Piano Transizione 4.0/5.0' is the Italian government incentive program for Industry 4.0.

commonMistakes: Using informal 'tu' instead of formal 'Lei' in professional software
Using 'performance' (English loanword) instead of 'prestazione' for OEE performance
Leaving 'setup' in English for manufacturing setup — use 'attrezzaggio'
Inconsistent 'fermo' vs 'tempo di fermo' — use 'fermo' for stop event, 'tempo di fermo' for duration

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'cause delle perdite di velocità' (WRONG — 'delle perdite' pluralizes the modifier) instead of 'cause di perdita di velocità' (CORRECT — 'perdita' stays singular as it names the concept). Only the head noun should take plural
notes: OEE acronym is commonly used; formal Lei form. WCM (Fiat) methodology is influential. P95 expansion 1.80x. CEN member with UNI EN ISO 22400.
